sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Donand is an obscure Irish goddess. The Book of Invasions notes her as the mother of three heroes. These are Brian, Iuchair, and Iucharba, called the Sons of Tuireann. Scholars usually treat Donand as identical to Danu. She may originally have been a separate goddess.

okr.objective: Record Donand as the obscure Irish mother-goddess of the Sons of Tuireann.
key_results: The Book of Invasions names Donand as mother of Brian, Iuchair, and Iucharba.
Her three sons are called the Sons of Tuireann.
Scholars usually identify Donand with the goddess Danu.
She may originally have been a separate goddess.
